answers.question: Levels' real names as signposted
answers.answer: Not settled. Ground level has no signposted name in any source. The tunnel is 'Asematunneli' in OSM and 'Kouvolan aseman henkilötunneli' in Väylävirasto's structure list; signage not confirmed.

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: From Asematunneli: lift + two stairs up to each island platform (3/4, 6/7, 9/10), two stairs up to platform 1, and lift + stairs + escalator at the station-building end. Positions are OSM only; Väylävirasto confirms an accessible route to every platform; VR confirms step-free entry from the hall to platform 1.
